profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Application Developer, performance engineer in java based-applications. Successfully delivered high quality Java/J2EE applications using wide variety of Open Source/Commercial frameworks/products. Interested in large scale/volume projects with scalability concerns.

Specialties: Languages: Java, Python
Performance analysis, loadtests, profiling
Linux/Unix
DBMS: MySQL, Junior Oracle 10g DBA skills, SQL server
Application servers: tomcat, weblogic, jboss
Frameworks: Spring, Struts, Hibernate
SOA: web-services
Web technologies: Javascript, HTML, CSS, AJAX
Design patterns

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Globant vendor)
positions.description:
Implemented/improved signup flow for YouTube partner program to onboard users for monetization.
Kudos received for increased code coverage/robustness and simplified code by means of unit/functional testing, which in turn helped document the use cases.
Reviewed code of peer workers to ensure style and quality.
Frontend development: test driven development of Media Publisher frontend

Key technologies: Python, Java, GWT 2.1.1, MVP pattern, google-gin, Event Bus, Activity/Places framework, Data Presentation widgets (CellList/CellTable).

Designed and developed RESTful shopping cart service to enable sell of car rental, hotel rooms and theme park / flight tickets.

Key technologies: Apache CXF, Apache Xml RPC client

company.name: Walt Disney Parks and Resorts Online

positions.title: WebServices Tech Lead
positions.description:
Took ownership on Intraway provisioning suite web services in PHP (SOAP RPC style).
Created distributed load test suites for (a)synchronous SOAP WebService APIs using JMeter and Maven Performance plug-in. The reports include response times (avg/median/max/min), crash point (ramp-up tests), remote system load (cpu/disk/mem/net provided by rstatd) and performance trend across the builds. Other services also included in the test are RDBMS and HTTP server loadtest.
Introduced WebService service level monitoring using Nagios.

Key technologies: JAX-RS, JAX-WS, PHP, XML, Maven2, JMeter
Tech talks: JMeter, XML Schema
